text:
Ana Chen: Heads up — prepping the Datadog embed demo for next Friday. Focus is the inference heatmap + trace linking from our runtime to Datadog APM. We need to finalize what attributes we send (privacy + size constraints) and confirm embargo timing.

Ben Li: Thanks Ana. Can you call out the exact privacy concerns? marketplace QA wants a short list so legal can sign off. Also pinging the product-marketing embargo calendar. :calendar:

Ana Chen: Main concerns: request payloads may have user-provided text (we should never send raw prompt), stable request_id mapping so Datadog can link logs->traces without PII, and GPU identifiers (we can hash). Also worried about span cardinality blowing up the heatmap.

Sam Rodriguez: From Datadog SI side — agreed on no raw prompts. Best practice: send model metadata + hashed request_id + metrics (latency_ms, token_count, seq_len). Collector side sampler should drop or redact prompt attribute. We can add a small OTLP processor example.

Sam Rodriguez: ```yaml
processors:
  batch:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: prompt
        action: delete
      - key: request_id
        action: hash
  sampling:
    probabilistic:
      sampling_percentage: 5
```

Kai Morris: Hashing GPU ids works, but ensure we keep per-pool cardinality low. For heatmap we actually want bucketed seq_len, e.g., "<128", "128-512", ">512" to avoid thousands of labels. Also watch out for span size when we attach model logits — large arrays will break dashboard ingestion.

Ana Chen: Good call on bucketing. Proposed attribute list (minimal): `model_name`, `model_version`, `request_id_h`, `latency_ms`, `seq_bucket`, `gpu_hash`, `status_code`. Optional (only for deeper debug): `token_count`, `kv_cache_misses`. No prompt, no raw inputs.

Ben Li: Marketing asks for two dashboards: "Overview heatmap" and "Ops drilldown". Ops drilldown can be gated behind NDA/enterprise only. We should add that to the marketplace tile gating doc.

Sam Rodriguez: Ops drilldown gating is fine. We'll wire the marketplace tile to use a prebuilt dashboard JSON; Sam (Datadog) can provide a starter dashboard. We just need the attribute names to match exactly.

Ana Chen: I'll own the attribute mapping and the redact/hash rules. Delivery target: Thursday EOD for the mapping + sample OTLP config. Can @Ben Li and @Sam Rodriguez confirm they can review by Friday AM?

Ben Li: I can review Friday AM. Adding to calendar now.

Sam Rodriguez: I'll review Friday AM and share a starter dashboard JSON by Friday noon.

Kai Morris: I'll run a quick perf test to measure span payload bloat — ETA Friday EOD.

deploy-bot: Demo slot reserved: 2026-03-27 14:00 UTC — please ensure assets are uploaded to /shared/marketplace/demo-assets by 2026-03-26.

Ana Chen: Great. Action items: (1) Ana -> mapping + OTLP config (due Thu EOD) (2) Sam -> starter dashboard JSON (Fri noon) (3) Ben -> embargo/calendar check (in progress) (4) Kai -> perf span size numbers (Fri EOD). Thanks all :thumbsup:

Ben Li: One more note — legal asked for a one-line explainer for the marketplace listing: "Telemetry includes hashed request identifiers and aggregated metrics only; customer data (prompts) is redacted." I'll draft and post here for sign-off.

Ana Chen: Perfect. If we hit any blocker on attr parity, let's escalate to the observability engineering triage right away.

Sam Rodriguez: Link for reference: https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/otlp-collector-setup (will attach dashboard JSON once ready).

Ana Chen: Thanks team — will post the OTLP snippet here when ready.
